body:
Indeed, this would work:

```js
sort((a, b) => (a.type === 'numeric' ? a.value - b.value : 0)),
```

The value is a number because it's converted beforehand: https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/blob/011d47909894837f2c2da5088bc81803135d201b/src/connectors/current-refinements/connectCurrentRefinements.js#L261

I can therefore remove the `compareObjects()` function.
